title: Marketing Automation Engineer
description: <h1>Growth at CFO Insights</h1> <p>Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.</p> <p>The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.</p> <p>You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.</p> <p>If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.</p> <h2><strong>Why CFO Insights</strong></h2> <p>CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.</p> <p>CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.</p> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Master the highest bar in the world.</strong> Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.</li> <li><strong>Unlimited growth potential. </strong>You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.</li> <li><strong>Skills that compound for life.</strong> Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.</li> <li><strong>Ownership from the very start.</strong> You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.</li> <li><strong>Travel opportunity.</strong> You will be joining our 10+ conferences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <p>Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build the audience.</strong> Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.</li> <li><strong>Own marketing channels that drive revenue. </strong>Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue</li> <li><strong>Write copy that persuades.</strong> Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.</li> <li><strong>Sprint, test, implement.</strong> Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.</li> <li><strong>Build systems, not one-offs.</strong> Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.</li> <li><strong>Do whatever it takes to win.</strong> Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we expect from you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>1 to 3 years of experience</li> <li>Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results</li> <li>A UK work permit. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Partnering with internal subject matter experts, you will help champion the JFrog point of view and narrative across key industry organizations, conferences, strategic customer engagements, and top-tier analyst briefings.</li> <li><strong>Translate Security & Compliance into Value:</strong> Convert complex global regulatory requirements, audit frameworks, and security mandates into compelling, differentiated product narratives that resonate with CISOs, Chief Risk Officers, and engineering leaders.</li> <li><strong>Accelerate Enterprise GTM:</strong> Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Marketing leadership to craft scalable, high-impact sales and marketing motions and playbooks that shorten sales cycles and win multi-million-dollar deals.</li> <li><strong>Influence Product Innovation:</strong> Leverage deep market research, competitive intelligence, and field feedback to directly influence the product roadmap, ensuring our <strong>security and </strong>GRC capabilities stay ahead of emerging threats, regulatory shifts, and the rapid adoption of AI technologies.</li> </ul> <h5><strong>To be a </strong><strong>Director of Product Marketing </strong><strong>at JFrog you will…</strong></h5> <ul> <li><strong>Experience at Scale:</strong> 10+ years of Product Marketing experience, including proven success at the Director level. You understand how AI impacts the software supply chain and can confidently articulate the governance implications of adopting AI models and agentic architectures. </li> <li><strong>Operational Scalability:</strong> You bring proven experience utilizing AI to build a highly scalable, agentic product marketing function, leveraging AI workflows to automate content generation, scale GTM execution, and drive operational efficiency.</li> <li><strong>Category Creation Mastery:</strong> Demonstrated success in building new markets and driving category creation from the ground up, with a portfolio of successful product launches in nascent or rapidly evolving tech spaces.</li> <li><strong>Market Development:</strong> Direct, hands-on experience scaling enterprise products and developing successful go-to-market strategies tailored to each region, especially EMEA.</li> <li><strong>Security & Regulatory Fluency:</strong> A strong security background combined with compliance and regulatory experience; you must be highly comfortable discussing security posture, risk management, and navigating global standards (e.g., NIST, ISO, DORA) with enterprise executives.</li> <li><strong>Proven GTM Success:</strong> A documented history of strategic go-to-market execution, driving high-growth revenue, and equipping global enterprise sales teams with the narrative and tools to win.</li> <li><strong>Executive Presence:</strong> Exceptional storytelling and presentation skills, with the credibility to seamlessly engage technical practitioners, risk executives, and industry analysts alongside our Field CISOs.</li> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Information Security, Computer Science, or equivalent practical industry experience.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Orchestrate cross-functionally : sequence Legal Engineers, Product, Solutions and Support around integrations and rollouts, and bring the voice of in-house customers back to Product and Engineering. Prove value and expand : align each legal team on measurable outcomes, capture ROI evidence and value stories the GC can take to the business, and qualify expansion into new teams and regions with your Account Executive. Run your book and own renewal readiness : know whether each account is in Defend, Maintain or Grow with evidence; prioritise by value, renewal timing and risk; surface risk early — including competing AI tools — and partner with your Account Executive to renew and expand our strategic partnerships. What You Have Extensive background in strategic customer success or account management at Enterprise SaaS, legal (big law or in-house or in-house) or top tier management consulting firms. History and comfort conducting change management and wide-scale adoption for large technology projects. Results driven mindset and the ability to ruthlessly prioritize competing tasks and demanding customers seamlessly. A strong commitment to be collaborative and proactive with a team-first mentality. What We Offer Ideal candidates for the Enterprise In-House CSM role at Harvey can demonstrate comfort and experience with the following: 5+ years in customer-owning roles — Customer Success, account management, legal operations, legal-tech consulting or an in-house legal or transformation role — working with corporate legal teams or an equivalent enterprise function. An understanding of how in-house legal teams work: how a General Counsel is measured, how legal operations runs change, and how legal interacts with IT, procurement and the business. An AI-native way of working: you use AI and sophisticated tooling daily, can show how it has changed your own output, and have a point of view on how AI changes in-house legal work. A track record of leading enterprise implementations or transformation programmes across multiple teams, regions or stakeholder groups, with measurable outcomes grounded in concrete use cases. Confidence in technical conversations about workspace configuration, integrations, permissions and data handling, and judgement on when to bring in specialists. Strategic planning and revenue-based prioritisation across a portfolio, including early identification and mitigation of risk. title: Director / VP, Online Growth
description: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position description We are looking for a senior leader to own and grow our Online business end to end. Sonar has one of the largest developer communities in software — with millions of developers using our free products, and that free adoption continues to grow. There is a significant opportunity in converting more of that engaged free base into paying customers, and in capturing new demand directly through our online business. This is a true general manager role: you own the P&L for the Online business and you own the operating motion that grows it. You will define Sonar’s product-led growth strategy, build the cross-functional engine to execute it — product, growth marketing, web, lifecycle, sales-assist, and self-serve customer success — and be accountable for the number. You will report directly into our Executive Leadership Team (ELT), and will partner daily with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Data. What You Will do: Own the Online P&L: Carry the number for self-serve ARR across new, expansion, retention, and churn. Set the plan, build the operating model and forecast, and report performance to the executive team with a clear line of sight from funnel inputs to revenue. Define and land the online growth strategy: Set the pricing, packaging, trial, and monetization architecture that supports our online sales motion. Decide deliberately where self-serve ends and human assistance begins. Monetize the free base: Turn a large, engaged free population into paying customers by prioritizing high-intent and high-utilization cohorts, and building the behavioral triggers, in-product prompts, lifecycle messaging, and upgrade paths that reach them at the right moment. Own activation and time-to-value: Own a seamless self–service signup, onboarding, upgrade experience; work closely with our Customer Success team to make sure users reach real product value before we ask them to pay. Grow top-of-funnel demand: Work with our demand generation team on web, SEO/AEO, paid acquisition, and conversion-rate optimization for the self-serve funnel. Grow qualified signup and trial volume without diluting quality, on a disciplined experimentation cadence with clear success criteria. Build the product-led sales motion: Stand up the sales-assist layer, including SDR coverage, qualified lead scoring, routing, and handoff rules, with clean boundaries and logic between Online, SMB, and the sales-led business. Grow retention and lifetime value: Own GRR and NRR for the Online business, and grow revenue per customer through LOC expansion, multi-product attach, and upgrade options. Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing: Act as the commercial voice to the product organization, influence the roadmap for areas that are core to online growth areas such as signup, onboarding, billing, and in-product monetization. Work cross-functionally with all four teams to enact the programs and changes needed. Make the business measurable: Establish a single source of truth for Online performance, and get product, billing, and usage telemetry into the systems so signups, trials, activation, conversion, utilization, expansion, and churn are visible, trusted, and actionable. Build the team: Define the org, hire and develop the team under you, and set the operating rhythm of weekly growth reviews, a live experiment pipeline, and a culture that ships, measures, and learns quickly. Experience & Qualifications The ideal candidate will: Bring 12+ years of experience across growth, product, and commercial leadership, including 5+ years leading teams at Director or VP level, time in a developer-focused or technical SaaS business is a plus. Have owned a P&L or a revenue line for a self-serve, freemium, or product-led business at scale, and have personally moved free-to-paid conversion, activation, or NRR, with the numbers to prove it. Demonstrate deep fluency in growth mechanics: funnel and cohort analysis, pricing and packaging, trial design, in-product monetization, lifecycle marketing, and rigorous experimentation. Have strong experience with A/B testing and experimentation, including designing, running, and interpreting experiments that drive measurable gains in conversion, activation, and retention. Have built or run a product-led sales motion, including qualified lead definition, scoring, routing, sales-assist coverage, and the organizational boundaries and incentives that keep it working. Be highly quantitative and comfortable working directly in the data, forming their own view from cohorts and telemetry, and knowing the difference between a metric moving and a business improving. Be credible with a developer audience, understanding how developers adopt tools bottom-up, what earns trust in that community, and what destroys it. Operate effectively across functions without formal authority, aligning Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Data on a shared growth agenda and keeping them moving. Bring sharp prioritization instincts: read a business honestly, pick a small number of high-leverage bets rather than spreading thin, and show measurable progress in quarters rather than years. Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and embody Sonar's CODE values: Committed, Obsessed with quality, Deliberate, and Effective. In-office culture We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. title: Senior Marketing Manager, Grocery & Retail, UK and Ireland
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. About the role Deliveroo is seeking a commercially driven, strategic and execution-focused Head of New Verticals Marketing to lead the next phase of growth across our grocery and retail businesses in the UK & Ireland. On-demand grocery and retail are among the most exciting parts of our business: customers increasingly want their weekly shop, everyday essentials and gifts delivered quickly, and we help the top grocers and retailers grow to meet these needs. You will shape and deliver the UK & Ireland marketing strategy across grocery and retail, managing the marketing budget and driving category positioning, partner growth and campaign excellence, and lead a team to bring it to life. Working at the intersection of Marketing, Commercial, Growth, Product and Analytics, you will act as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders and some of the biggest brands in the UK & Ireland, driving measurable commercial impact. This is a chance to make your mark with real influence over strategy, partners and investment. What you'll be doing Strategy, planning and performance Shape and lead the grocery and retail marketing strategy for the UK & Ireland, tied to ambitious growth targets and informed by what customers, categories and performance are telling us. Build annual and quarterly plans around the missions and moments that matter to UK & Ireland shoppers, from the weekly shop to key seasonal and trading events. Balance brand building and performance marketing to drive sustainable acquisition, retention and frequency, with disciplined, ROI-led investment. Own the growth targets and KPIs for grocery and retail, monitor performance and course-correct quickly. Set the measurement framework, lead post-campaign analysis and turn learnings into sharper plans, presenting results to leadership. Bring Commercial, Product, Growth and Analytics together to solve cross-functional problems and give structure to new, fast-moving areas. Category and propositions Develop a distinctive, data-led category strategy for grocery and retail, with clear positioning and value propositions that stand out for customers and partners. Turn market trends and shopper behaviour into scalable growth plans for partners. Share what works in the UK & Ireland with other markets and tailor global strategy to local needs. Partners and growth Build strong marketing partnerships with leading grocers and retailers, from joint business plans to integrated campaigns, helping them grow on Deliveroo and shaping propositions customers love. Own the working partnership with Commercial leadership, supporting the winning and launch of new partners. Drive integrated, creative marketing plans across CRM, social, paid media, PR and in-app that unlock incremental growth, with a high bar for execution. Leading the team Lead and develop a team of five, including two direct reports: set priorities and standards and develop their careers. Build efficient ways of working, using automation and AI. Foster a culture of innovation, ownership and executional excellence. Key skills and experience Significant senior marketing leadership experience (10+ years), ideally in retail, grocery, marketplace, eCommerce or tech. Strong commercial and data fluency with a test-and-learn mindset: turn performance data into plans and defensible trade-offs, make sound investment decisions with incomplete data, and manage substantial budgets with measurable impact. Experience building and executing multi-channel marketing strategies across acquisition, retention and brand. Stakeholder management and influence, including joint business planning with large strategic partners, negotiating and building consensus across partners and internal teams. Experience launching and scaling new propositions, categories or physical locations (e.g. stores). Knowledge of the UK & Ireland grocery and retail landscape, and how shoppers behave in it. Outstanding organisation and project management with exceptional attention to detail. Comfortable operating autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. People leadership: able to direct and develop a team with different levels of seniority. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. title: VP of Sales, EMEA
description: A little about us incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime. The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously. We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join. The role in one line This is the seat where EMEA goes from early traction to a real engine: you own the number, you build the team, and you stay close enough to the deals to feel every one of them. What that looks like day to day Our GTM team is growing quickly. In London we already have pods across Enterprise Sales, Commercial Sales, Customer Success, BDR and Solutions Engineering, with a mix of internally promoted and externally hired first-line and segment leaders in place. You own the EMEA revenue number, including new business and the bulk of net retention across Commercial, Mid-Market and Enterprise. You lead the EMEA sales org directly, setting the bar on hiring, performance, coaching and territory design. You partner with in-region CS, SE, BDR and expansion account management to make the full regional motion work. This is not a role you can do from behind a forecast. You'll be in the deals, running exec-level conversations with CTOs, CIOs and CISOs, inspecting and coaching pipeline personally, and carrying the deals that need you. You'll also drive operational excellence across pipeline reviews, forecast calls, QBRs, recruiting, enablement, fiscal planning and territory design. Our leaders are close to the product, close to customers, and close to cross-functional peers. You'll work closely with our founders, COO, CMO, VP Finance, RevOps and Product, and build trust with Engineering, Marketing, Finance and company leadership. What you hear in region should influence the roadmap, and you'll contribute to company-wide planning and exec discussions, helping shape our global growth trajectory. We want a real point of view on AI in GTM. How your team prospects, researches, qualifies, forecasts and closes should look different because of it. You also set the cultural tone in London: a high performance bar, and a culture people want to be part of. Who you are You're based in or around London, and you're up for travelling across EMEA and occasionally to the US. You've built an EMEA revenue engine from roughly $XXM to $XXXM at a high-growth B2B software company, and you have the appetite and resilience to take us from early traction to sustained scale in a Series B environment. You've built and scaled sales teams across Commercial, Mid-Market and Enterprise, and you know how the motion, hiring bar and cadence differ across each. You're hands-on. You still get into deals, run discovery, coach live calls and hold a point of view on the product. You're not two layers removed from the customer. You understand technical sales and have a track record selling to CTOs, CIOs and CISOs. You have a real point of view on leveraging AI in GTM, grounded in things you've actually rolled out rather than things you've read about. You keep a high performance bar while building a culture aligned with our values. We want both, and candidates who can only do one are not a fit. You're also an exceptional recruiter who attracts and retains A-players, and people follow you. You build trust extensively across Engineering, Product and company leadership, and you're operationally excellent, with a bias for clarity, measurement and predictable execution. Bonus points if you have experience scaling footprint into other European markets such as France, DACH and the Nordics. VP of EMEA Sales experience at a high-growth SaaS company scaling from $XXM to $XXXM+ is a plus, as is senior regional leadership at a $10B+ B2B software company with material revenue responsibility. We'd also love experience selling to engineering and SRE buyers in the reliability, observability, monitoring or DevOps space, early channel and alliances go-to-market experience, and the ability to lead cross-cultural teams across Europe. Supporting you We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both. Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after. Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that. First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously. Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought. Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it. Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too. Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them. Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution. We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints. With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge? About the role We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform team and help us build reliable software for a complex, real-world AI product. The Platform team works across a broad range of problems at Gigaton, from CI/CD for our monorepo and networking and data integration with on-premise plant systems, to hardening our IoT OS image and building customer-facing software around our control systems. The work is currently split across two squads: Enablement, focused on helping engineers move faster. Product, focused on supporting our control software. Whichever squad you join, you’ll work across technically challenging problems with plenty of scope to learn, contribute and shape how we build software. Your main responsibilities Write reliable, well-tested software in Python and Terraform. Monitor, support and improve software running in production. Mentor less experienced engineers and help them develop their craft. Identify, articulate and drive architectural improvements. Bring strong software engineering practices to code developed across the wider engineering and ML teams. Contribute to improving the quality, maintainability and reliability of our systems. Bonus experience You don’t need all of these, but experience in any of the following would be useful: Control engineering, machine learning or MLOps. AWS IoT, Greengrass or Mender for managing device fleets. Working across multiple cloud environments, such as AWS, GCP or Azure. Managing CI/CD environments using GitHub Actions. Building production artefacts using tools such as Docker. Functional programming languages such as Haskell, F# or Elm. Building or working with more complex AI-enabled workflows beyond simple prompting. You’ll excel if you are Excited by complex technical domains and enjoy getting to grips with unfamiliar systems. Highly collaborative and comfortable working across software, ML and other disciplines. Familiar with practices such as testing, pairing, mobbing and iterative software development. Pragmatic about engineering trade-offs and know when good enough now is better than perfect later. Comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving requirements. Able to improve existing systems, not just build new ones from scratch. Happy to take ownership of problems and follow them through into production. 💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match. We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from different countries, cultures and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you. The interview process Our interview process is designed to help us understand your experience, how you think and how you work with others, while giving you plenty of opportunity to get to know Gigaton too. 1. Talent Partner conversation You’ll start with a conversation with our Talent Partner. We’ll talk through your background, what you’re looking for and what interests you about Gigaton. We’ll also give you more context on the role, the team and the interview process, and answer any initial questions you have. 2. Hiring Manager interview Next, you’ll meet the hiring manager for a deeper conversation about your experience and some of the technical problems you’ve worked on. We’ll explore the work you’ve owned, the decisions you’ve made, how you approach engineering trade-offs and whether the role feels like a strong match on both sides. 3a. Pair Programming - remote session You’ll work with one of our engineers on a small technical exercise using Python and Terraform. We’re not assessing memorised syntax or speed under pressure. We’re interested in how you reason, collaborate, use tests to guide your work, learn from documentation or tools, and communicate while solving an unfamiliar problem. 3b. Technical Onsite This technical stage takes place in our London office and consists of one session. System design You’ll walk us through a real system you’ve worked on and had meaningful influence over. We’ll ask about the problem, constraints, operational characteristics, design decisions, trade-offs and how the system evolved over time. This isn’t a formal presentation. You’ll introduce the system for around 10–15 minutes, then we’ll explore it together in more depth. 4. Operating Principles interview We’ll discuss examples from your past experience that relate to how we work at Gigaton: Concrete Honesty Autonomous Ownership Go Gig or Go Home Cement It with Fun and Kindness We’re interested in specific examples of how you’ve demonstrated these behaviours in practice rather than abstract culture-fit questions. 5. CEO conversation Finally, you’ll meet Josh, our CEO. This is a chance to talk more broadly about Gigaton, our mission, where the company is heading and whether this feels like the right move for both sides. We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll conduct reference checks before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us too by speaking with team members you haven’t yet met. Once interviews are complete, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to provide feedback at any stage. In return for your hard work, we’ll give you 📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside. 🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team. 🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge 🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one. Our Operating Principles ↗️ Go Gig or Go Home : High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires. 🏭 Concrete Honesty : Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture. 🦾 Autonomous Ownership : High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it. 😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun : Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page. title: Senior Account Executive, Strategic Pod
description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Sales team Sales at hx is driving exceptional growth in one of the world’s most complex industries, partnering with globally recognised insurers including Aviva, Markel, Munich Re, Beazley, and others across EMEA and the US. This is where AI, SaaS, and specialty insurance converge, and where we help leading insurers transform how they underwrite and price risk. Our Strategic Sales team works on the largest and most complex opportunities at hx: multi-year, seven-figure partnerships that sit at the centre of our customers’ underwriting and pricing transformation. These deals involve long, high-touch sales cycles and require you to win the trust of actuaries, underwriters, IT leaders, and C-suite executives. This is not transactional sales. The people who thrive here take ownership of ambiguity, build deep credibility with customers, and solve problems others can’t. They move seamlessly between strategy and execution, shaping how enterprise insurers adopt and scale AI-powered decision-making. What you’ll be doing Own and execute a strategic territory plan across the UK and EMEA, building and closing a pipeline of high-value opportunities with enterprise insurers in your named accounts. Consistently deliver and exceed enterprise revenue targets by closing seven-figure, multi-year partnerships that become long-term, strategic relationships rather than one-off wins. Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders including C-suite, actuarial, underwriting, and technology leaders, positioning hx as a long-term transformation partner rather than a point solution. Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with structure and discipline, qualifying deeply, managing risk, and maintaining control from first conversation through to close and handover. Orchestrate cross-functional teams across pre-sales, product, professional services, and leadership to deliver cohesive, high-impact engagements that move deals forward and set customers up for successful adoption. Represent hx in the market and build enduring customer relationships, using industry events, executive forums, and ongoing account engagement to unlock additional value for clients and support hx’s long-term growth and category leadership. What you’ll need to have done Sold B2B SaaS in complex, enterprise environments, ideally into regulated, technical, or analytical buyer groups such as financial services or insurance. Consistently delivered against enterprise-level quotas, with a proven track record of closing multi-year, high-value new business deals and driving expansion within strategic accounts. Led structured, rigorous sales processes using methodologies such as MEDDICC, Challenger, or similar, and can point to specific deals where this discipline helped you qualify deeply, manage risk, and keep control of long cycles. Built credibility with senior stakeholders, including C-suite, actuarial, underwriting, and technology leaders, by demonstrating depth of understanding, sound commercial judgement, and an ability to navigate complex organisations. Operated in long, high-touch, multi-stakeholder sales cycles where success depended on education, alignment, and trust, translating complex technology and abstract value into clear commercial outcomes. Owned a territory with care and discipline, using tools like Salesforce for accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and planning, and demonstrating an ownership mindset in how you drive outcomes. How we build in an AI-forward company hx is a maximally AI-forward company because we believe AI should amplify what exceptional people can achieve. Everyone here is a builder. That means staying close to what’s changing, continuing to learn, and using AI to raise the quality, pace and ambition of your work. We expect everyone to actively experiment with AI and agentic systems, whether at work or in their personal lives. This means going beyond prompting, exploring what agents can do autonomously, and learning by doing. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to be curious, hands-on and willing to push what's possible. Your current environment is context, not the answer. We’re interested in how you think about what should be possible now, not simply how things are done where you work today. We care about judgement, creativity and ownership, not simply using more tools. The bar is simple: your work should be meaningfully better because of how you operate in this new world. Regular hackathons, lunch & learns, and socials, both remote and in-person, to foster collaboration and creativity. Team breakfasts and lunches, fully stocked snacks and drinks, and a fun, creative office at The Ministry . Access to cutting-edge AI tools and an experimentation budget, giving you the freedom to test, learn, and innovate ahead of the market. title: Director of Product Marketing, Models and Research
description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. About the role Mistral is building the world’s most capable open-weight AI models. Our ambition is to cement Mistral among the top AI research organizations globally, recognized for frontier-level research, open models, and the ability to solve problems that general-purpose AI cannot. We’re looking for a Director of Product Marketing to help make that happen. You’ll work directly with our scientists, applied researchers, and product teams to bring Mistral’s research to market. Your focus not only be to drive leadership perception at the frontier, but also for our Specialist and Forged models, establishing their leadership in areas such as speech, document intelligence, cybersecurity, and enterprise-specific AI. You’ll need to understand the science, identify where our models have a technical advantage, and turn that advantage into compelling evidence that influences developers, researchers, and enterprise customers. This is a highly technical, hands-on marketing leadership role with direct influence over how Mistral’s research is positioned, evaluated, launched, and adopted. What you’ll do Establish Mistral’s models as category leaders. Own positioning and go-to-market strategy for our Generalist. Specialist, and Forged models. Identify the capabilities and workloads where we can lead, develop the competitive narrative, and work with Science and Product to bring differentiated models to market. Turn research into compelling technical marketing. Translate complex scientific advances into technical reports, research articles, demonstrations, competitive comparisons, and content that developers and enterprises actually want to read. Work closely with our researchers to explain breakthroughs in training, architecture, inference, and model customization. Show enterprises why model customization matters. Partner with Applied, Industry Marketing, and Customer Programs to demonstrate how enterprises can build, fine-tune, optimize, and own models tailored to their workloads. Publish technical customer stories, customization benchmarks, and purpose-built model research, including work originating from enterprise engagements. Shape our research roadmap through market intelligence. Stay close to frontier AI developments, competing models, emerging benchmarks, and enterprise requirements. Bring actionable competitive intelligence back to Science and Product to inform model positioning, evaluation priorities, and future releases. Skills we’re looking for Technical fluency in AI models. You understand how modern foundation models are trained, evaluated, fine-tuned, and deployed. You can read a technical paper, interrogate a benchmark, and identify what metrics matter. A track record marketing technically sophisticated products. You’ve led product marketing for AI models, ML infrastructure, developer platforms, or similarly technical products. You’ve demonstrated the ability to establish technical differentiation and turn it into developer adoption or enterprise demand. Exceptional technical storytelling. You can take a complex research breakthrough and explain why it matters without exaggeration or jargon. You’re equally comfortable writing a technical launch post, challenging an evaluation methodology, and presenting a competitive argument to an enterprise CTO. Strong judgment and independent execution. You know which technical claims are worth making, which evidence will convince a skeptical audience, and which marketing activities will actually change market perception. You can drive complex initiatives across Science, Product, Engineering, and Marketing without relying on formal authority. Scientific credibility and curiosity. You follow frontier AI research closely, understand the competitive model landscape, and can earn the trust of research scientists. title: Product Engineer
description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent . We're a 180+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites , with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far. We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy. The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards , came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100 . Learn more about us on our website . 🚀 The Role We're hiring Product Engineers at Staff, Senior Staff, and Principal level across three of our engines: Buy, Sell and Third Party Access (TPA). A Product Engineer at tem gets handed a problem, not a ticket. You sit inside an engine, next to the account managers, partners and customers who live with the problem. You work out what to build, build it, and stay with it after launch until you can show it moved the metric. Product sets the bet and the guidance, not the feature list, so nobody writes your tickets for you. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management one. We will talk to you about which engine fits you best, and where your experience and interests line up. Buy: Buy is where businesses pay less for clean power. It's the side of tem that runs RED for the UK businesses on it: quotes with every cost up front, bills itemised line by line, and a switch from quote to live in minutes, not days. You'd build the products and systems behind that, from tender to signed contract to a bill with nothing to hide, and make it work just as well for the next thousand sites as it does for the first. Sell: Sell is where generators earn more for what they produce. We contract with UK solar, wind, hydro, anaerobic digestion, biomass and EfW sites, from single farms to multi-site portfolios, through broker partners and direct. You'd build the tools that get generators signed faster, show them exactly what they're earning, and get them paid on time, every time. You'd also open up new kinds of sites we can't contract today, so there's more clean power to put in front of businesses. Third Party Access (TPA): TPA builds the new transaction rails for our partners. It lets brokers, banks, affiliates and generators sell tem's energy under their own brand, running on Rosso, our pricing engine. You'd design and build the partner APIs, branded portals, billing and settlement that make that work, and take a 0 to 1 product from pilot to production. In TPA you'll also be partner-facing, embedding with partners to get them integrated and live. 📆 In your first 12 months, you might: Sit with the account managers, partners and customers in your engine, run discovery calls yourself and turn what you hear into a clear problem to solve. Decide what to build and what to leave out, then design and ship it without waiting for a spec. Ship work that moves a named business metric, and stay with it until you can show the number moved. In TPA, help take partner integrations from pilot to production, live and working. Mentor engineers around you and share what you learn with teams across the business. 🛠️ Responsibilities Own discovery: Work directly with the commercial team, partners and customers to find the real problem, proactively engaging them and running calls autonomously. Turn problems into outcomes: Turn subjective requirements into objective outcomes, deciding what to build, then designing and shipping it yourself. Be accountable for the number: Take full accountability for the business and user metrics that move as a direct result of your technical and customer work. Own it end to end: Stay with it after launch and make sure it moves what it was meant to move within the business. Make the hard calls: Make sound but critical judgement calls on speed versus robustness, and on commercial risk. Spread what you learn: Feed what you learn from partners and customers back into the product, with an impact across departments that aren't your own. Raise the bar: Mentor engineers around you and raise technical standards, helping others accelerate into roles you used to hold. ✅ Requirements Must-Haves Proven technical leadership at Senior, Staff or Senior Staff level, with genuine, statistical evidence of leading complex, ambiguous work to real business impact. Comfort operating without a spec, with several clear-cut examples of how you went against the status quo or ran without guidelines to deliver something impactful. Examples of talking directly to customers and commercial teams to find the real problem, participating in (if not leading) early discovery calls and user feedback interviews. Sound commercial judgement, including an understanding of the revenue impact of the risks you take and whether a headcount investment outweighs its costs. Comfort being the technical voice in front of commercial stakeholders and partners, from our leadership team through to our board members and investors. A hands-on, player-coach approach, and comfort in our stack: Python, TypeScript, AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EventBridge) and event-driven architectures. Desirable Experience in energy, fintech or another regulated, high-stakes commercial domain. Forward-deployed, solutions or customer-facing engineering experience. API, integration and multi-tenant or white-label platform design, which is especially useful for TPA. Experience taking a 0 to 1 product into production. 🎁 Benefits & Perks Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,200 per year for your remote setup. Up to GBP150 or EUR150 per month for wellbeing. 🤝 Interview Process First call with our Talent Team. Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager. Technical Interview with the Team. Culture-Add Interview with Stakeholders. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for. title: Senior Commercial Technology Lawyer
description: At Acturis, innovation isn’t just part of our culture - it’s in our DNA. Our journey began in 2000, when our founders set out to transform the way technology supports the insurance industry. Since then, we’ve grown from a UK start-up into an international technology group, bringing together a number of businesses, products and specialist teams across the UK, Europe and North America. At the heart of the Group is our market-leading SaaS platform, used by over 100,000 people in 40+ countries. Alongside this, our wider Group businesses provide technology and services across different areas of the insurance ecosystem, giving us an increasingly diverse and international footprint. We’re continuing to grow through international expansion, new products and services, and strategic acquisitions. That means the opportunities and challenges we take on are constantly evolving - whether we’re entering a new market, integrating a new business, developing AI-enabled products or supporting customers in highly regulated environments. You’ll join an ambitious organisation where expertise is valued, decisions move quickly and talented people can make a genuine impact across the wider Group. Day to day you will: Lead complex commercial technology work across a growing international group, including structuring, negotiating and advising on SaaS, technology licensing, customer and supplier agreements, data, AI and emerging digital regulation. Partner with senior leaders across the business to understand legal and commercial risk, make pragmatic recommendations and help move decisions and deals forward. Play a senior role within the Legal team, remaining hands-on with your own work while managing and developing junior colleagues , and driving building and maintaining legal function operational excellence. We offer a clear progression path and the opportunity to take genuine ownership as the Acturis Group continues to grow internationally. You’ll work closely with senior leaders, take responsibility for complex legal matters and play an active role in developing the wider Legal team and function. You can expect: The opportunity to take ownership of key areas of the Group and influence commercial and strategic decisions. To join a collegiate legal team with a strong reputation, both inside the company and across our industry, and who hold ourselves to high standards, work closely together, and take pride in the difference we make. A clear progression structure, regular feedback and ongoing career development. Support for relevant professional development and training as your role and responsibilities evolve. You’ll thrive here if: You’re a UK-qualified lawyer with 7+ years’ PQE with a combination of both private practice background in the City or a large regional practice and strong in-house commercial technology experience, ideally within a SaaS, software or technology business. You have deep knowledge of practice areas that underpin the commercial practice, including contract law, IP and privacy, including evolving regulatory frameworks. You’re commercially minded, decisive and comfortable operating at pace, able to cut through complexity, prioritise material risks and find practical ways forward. You have strong communication stills, a proactive mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You enjoy variety and ownership, whether that’s negotiating a complex SaaS agreement, advising on AI or data regulation, supporting an acquisition or coaching a junior lawyer. You have a strong work ethic with an eye for detail. You're a true team player who supports colleagues and works collaboratively across all Verticals of the business to drive growth and strategic initiatives. Ready to use your expertise to help shape the future of insurance technology? Join Acturis and take on a role where your impact is immediate, your ideas matter, and your progression is limitless. Please note Acturis is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, transgender status, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity. title: AI Solution Architect
description: Location: London Contract Type: 12-month contract Day Rate: £650–£750 per day We are looking for an experienced AI Solution Architect to join our Technology team, working onsite with a Tier 1 Bank in London on an initial 12-month contract. This is a hands-on role focused on designing and delivering scalable, production-ready AI solutions within a complex financial services environment. You will work across business, product, engineering and data teams, taking solutions from initial concept through to deployment and production. You will have particular expertise in Generative AI and LLM technologies, including RAG, agentic AI, document and unstructured data processing, and machine learning. We’re looking for someone who combines strong solution architecture expertise with a pragmatic approach to security, governance, scalability and production delivery. Key Responsibilities Design end-to-end architecture for AI-enabled solutions, covering applications, data, integrations and production environments. Translate business requirements into practical, scalable technical solutions. Select appropriate AI approaches, including Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, machine learning and hybrid solutions. Define APIs, integrations and data contracts across upstream and downstream systems. Ensure security, privacy, resilience and appropriate controls are embedded into solution design. Define non-functional requirements including availability, performance, latency, scalability and cost. Support deployment, monitoring, versioning and ongoing lifecycle management of AI solutions. Work closely with engineering teams to break architecture into deliverable solutions and resolve technical challenges. Produce clear architecture documentation, designs and technical decision records. Identify opportunities to create reusable architecture patterns and components. Manage technical risks, dependencies and architectural decisions throughout delivery. Skills & Experience Essential Proven experience as a Solution Architect within complex enterprise environments. Strong experience designing end-to-end technology solutions across applications, APIs, integration and data. Good understanding of AI and Generative AI architecture, including LLMs and RAG. Experience taking solutions from initial design through to production. Strong understanding of APIs, integration patterns and data contracts. Experience defining non-functional requirements across performance, resilience, security and scalability. Strong understanding of security, privacy and controls-by-design. Ability to make pragmatic technical decisions and clearly communicate architectural trade-offs. Strong stakeholder management skills across business and technology teams. Experience working within fast-paced Agile or product-led delivery environments. Desirable Experience working within banking, capital markets or wider financial services. Experience delivering technology within highly regulated environments. Knowledge of agentic AI and AI-enabled workflow automation. Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, including deployment, monitoring, versioning and rollback. Experience designing solutions involving document processing or unstructured data. Experience creating reusable architecture patterns or frameworks. How We Work: Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please use the designated space within the application questionnaire. This is a Contract role located in London with hybrid working. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible. If your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks. A valid UK working permit is mandatory for this role. Expectations regarding hybrid working: As we are a Service Provider and Consulting firm servicing clients, our policy for physically working from the office (which may be the clients' offices or our own offices depending on the client) aligns to what our clients' policies and expectations are and these vary. Most of our clients now require a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, 2 days from home, and accordingly this is also the minimum expectation that Delta Capita require. However, some of our clients have now moved up to 4 days and even 5 days in the office and we require candidates to be flexible to meet our client demands. Who We Are: Delta Capita Group is a global managed services, consulting, and solutions provider with a unique combination of experience in Financial Services and technology innovation capability. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. infrastructure</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="https://facebook.github.io/react/"><strong>React</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> for internal web dashboards</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">We also have two physical datacenter sites with actual cables to connect to various third parties</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Your day-to-day   </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This role is all about collaborating across disciplines to test hypotheses and make a difference to customers. 400;">Our interview process involves three main stages: </span></p> <ol> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Initial Call </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span title: Marketing Automation Engineer
description: <h1>Growth at Private Equity Insights</h1> <p>Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.</p> <p>The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.</p> <p>You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.</p> <p>If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.</p> <h2><strong>Why Private Equity Insights</strong></h2> <p>Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.</p> <p>Private Equity Insights is part of United Media (<a href="https://www.united-media.com/">https://www.united-media.com/</a>) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.</p> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Master the highest bar in the world.</strong> Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.</li> <li><strong>Unlimited growth potential. </strong>You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.</li> <li><strong>Skills that compound for life.</strong> Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.</li> <li><strong>Ownership from the very start.</strong> You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.</li> <li><strong>Travel opportunity.</strong> You will be joining our 10+ conferences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <p>Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build the audience.</strong> Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.</li> <li><strong>Own marketing channels that drive revenue. </strong>Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue</li> <li><strong>Write copy that persuades.</strong> Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.</li> <li><strong>Sprint, test, implement.</strong> Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.</li> <li><strong>Build systems, not one-offs.</strong> Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.</li> <li><strong>Do whatever it takes to win.</strong> Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we expect from you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>1 to 3 years of experience</li> <li>Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results</li> <li>A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.</li> <li>Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency</li> <li>Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do</li> <li>Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do</li> <li>A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people</li> <li>Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Practical details</strong></h2> <p>Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

This includes cloud-native IAM (AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD, Google Cloud IAM), enterprise identity services (AWS IAM Identity Center, Entra ID, Google Cloud Identity), and federation standards (SCIM, OAuth, SAML, OIDC). Experience with EMEA regulatory frameworks (GDPR, DORA, FCA/PRA, EU AI Act) and turning them into technical controls and evidence.</li> <li>Lead technical answers to customer security, vendor-risk and AI-readiness questionnaires, working with Trust and Security.</li> <li>Networking & Deployments: Enterprise cloud networking (VPC/VNet design and peering, dedicated interconnects such as AWS Direct Connect / Azure ExpressRoute / Google Cloud Interconnect, and private connectivity such as AWS PrivateLink / Azure Private Link / GCP Private Service Connect), network routing, performance optimisation, and large-scale deployment management</li> <li>Platform Administration: High availability, disaster recovery, cluster orchestration, observability and audit (e.g. Amazon CloudWatch / CloudTrail, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations Suite), and cloud cost management</li> <li>Infrastructure Automation (InfraOps): Hands-on automation using IaC tools (e.g. Terraform, plus cloud-native tooling such as AWS CloudFormation / CDK, Azure Resource Manager / Bicep, or Google Cloud Deployment Manager) to build, maintain, and scale complex cloud environments</li> </ul> <li>Solid grounding in distributed data systems architecture: scalable pipelines, streaming architectures, lakehouse patterns, and cloud-native data platforms</li> <li>Proficient on the Databricks Platform (or demonstrated ability to achieve proficiency rapidly) with a developing technical specialisation in one area (e.g. real-time/streaming, ML/AI, data governance, migrations)</li> <li>Ability to contribute to architecture discussions with senior technical stakeholders (including CISOs and risk/compliance stakeholders): whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off analysis. Own complex, cross-functional security engagements end to end.</li> <li>Track record unblocking adoption of new features (AI, serverless) by clearing security and compliance blockers within accounts.</li> <li>Contribute to Field Engineering thought leadership through customer-facing content, workshops, and community engagement</li> <li>Excellent communication skills: able to translate complex architectures into business value for both technical and executive audiences</li> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience)</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 30% as needed</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, ML, Platform)</li> <li>Cloud provider certifications at professional level (e.g. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or AWS Certified Data Engineer; Azure Solutions Architect Expert; Google Professional Cloud Architect)</li> <li>Experience with competitive platforms (Snowflake, cloud-native data services, Azure Synapse, BigQuery), understanding the landscape you'll position against</li> <li>Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company.
