title: Agency Lead - Middle Mile
description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation The Opportunity Every morning before most of the country is awake, Relay's middle mile moves parcels in vans from our sort centres to thousands of local shops we call pitstops. A big share of those vans and drivers come from partner agencies, which makes them one of the most important partnerships in the business. When an agency doesn't show up, or we simply don't have enough, parcels don't move, couriers wait and customers feel it that same day. When a contract is wrong, it hits our P&L directly. Right now our agency relationships run on ad hoc calls handled by our live support team. You'll be the person who changes that. You'll build proper account management from scratch, with clear standards, regular reviews and real consequences when standards slip. You'll make sure we always have enough reliable, compliant capacity at a price that works, and a bench of agencies ready to step in when one doesn't deliver. As we open new sort centres across the UK and expand internationally, you'll be the one finding and launching the agency partners that get each new region moving from day one. You won't just manage the process, you'll help rebuild it. You'll work side by side with our engineers to design a better experience for agencies and automate the manual work out of it. As engineering automations go live and more of the middle mile runs itself, the role grows with it. The playbook you build here becomes the blueprint for every new market we enter. It can widen into a Marketplace Partnerships Lead across all our supply: van and moped rental deals, background check and onboarding suppliers, local partnerships in areas where we need more couriers, and courier benefits programmes. Outcomes you own Agency shift fill. Agencies reliably fill the shifts gave to them, including at short notice and through peak. Agency driver attendance and quality. Agency drivers turn up for the shifts they accept, on time, trained and ready at the sort centre. Agency cost per shift. Rates and bonuses stay within budget, and every pound of premium we pay an agency earns its place. Agency supply pool. Each agency keeps enough onboarded drivers to ramp with us. An agency running the same four drivers every day has no flex. A healthy agency bench. Every agency knows how it ranks against our standards and its peers, and we always have a replacement ready for one that persistently underperforms. What you’ll do Own every agency relationship. Be the single point of contact for all our middle mile driver agencies. Run weekly account calls, step in fast when performance dips, and build relationships that hold up on the hardest peak mornings. Hold agencies to account. Track fill, attendance and driver quality for every agency and share it with them. When one falls short, find out why: separate what’s on us (route length, late shift release) from what’s on them (no-shows, hand-backs), and agree a fix with a target, a date and an owner. Fix the cause rather than paying more to cover it. Own contracts, rates and terms. Negotiate rates, bonuses and contract terms. Use data to compare agencies before every rate conversation, and know when to walk away from a deal that doesn’t work for us. Build the bench. Source, vet and contract new agencies in each region. Start them small, scale the ones that deliver and replace the ones that don’t, so we’re never dependent on one low performer. Be the escalation point. Live Ops handles day-to-day shift fill. When an agency misses its agreement, is unhappy with how we’re working with them, or sort centre teams see a pattern of problems with its drivers, you resolve it. Shape new ways of working. We’re automating how agencies receive and book shifts. Be the expert on what works for agencies, advise Product and Engineering on the designs, and move every agency onto the new process. What you’ll need Ownership. You run outcomes, not tasks. A good week is one where agency fill, attendance and cost move the right way. Hands-on ops experience. You’ve worked in logistics, delivery, transport or a similar fast-moving operation, and can run the operational work yourself rather than hand it off. Supplier or account management. You’ve managed agencies, subcontractors or a third-party workforce, ideally with commercial targets attached. Comfort with hard conversations. You hold partners to what they agreed, challenge excuses and keep the relationship intact. Ops judgement under pressure. At 05:30 with a van broken down, you work out what’s most at risk, make the call and tell the right people what happens next. Comfort with data. You can turn a volume plan into shifts per day by site, read a dashboard and question a number. Spreadsheets are a must; SQL is a plus. Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new role in a fast-growing network. You’ll shape how it works rather than inherit a playbook. Fast and focused hiring process Talent Acquisition interview – 30 mins Hiring Manager interview – 45 mins Case interview: live role plays of real agency situations – 1 hour Decision and offer within 48 hours. Our process mirrors our pace of work. Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect. Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Treasury
description: About Zable Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money . Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021 The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices. The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more. Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting What you'll do Strategic Financial Planning: Collaborating with senior management to develop and execute treasury strategies aligned with our business objectives. You will provide expert guidance on liquidity management, capital allocation, and risk mitigation to optimize our financial performance. Treasury Operations: Overseeing the operational aspects of treasury, including cash management, foreign exchange, and hedging activities. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to streamline processes, enhance efficiency, and leverage technology to automate treasury operations. Cash Flow Management: Overseeing the day-to-day cash flow operations, including forecasting, monitoring, and reporting. You will ensure that our liquidity needs are met efficiently, minimizing idle cash and maximizing investment opportunities. Treasury Portfolio Management: Work with Capital Markets to establish optimum investment strategy for Treasury assets. Source, evaluate and manage portfolio investments. Risk Management: Implementing robust risk management practices to safeguard our financial position. You will assess and mitigate financial risks, such as interest rate, liquidity, and credit risks, while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements in both the UK and US markets. Stakeholder Management: Building and maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including regulators, auditors, and investors. You will effectively communicate our treasury strategies, financial performance, and risk management practices to ensure transparency and trust. Team Leadership: Leading and developing a lean high-performing treasury team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. You will provide guidance, mentorship, and support to empower your team members to excel in their roles. What we’re looking for Extensive experience in treasury management, preferably within the consumer lending, asset management or banking sectors. Strong knowledge of UK and US financial markets, regulations, and best practices. Proven track record in strategic financial planning, cash flow management, and risk mitigation. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions. Expertise in treasury operations and systems implementation and management. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships at all levels. Strong leadership capabilities, with a passion for developing and motivating teams. Excited about the opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment and have a real impact on the business Professional qualifications such as ACT, CFA, or ACCA are desirable. Life at Zable The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner. Check out our Glassdoor Reviews and blog ! Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Client Services Manager - Bridging
description: About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. Department Description The Bridging Department at Allica Bank is a high-energy, specialist lending team supporting established SMEs and professional property investors with fast, flexible short-term finance. Operating within a true challenger-bank environment, the team combines strong credit discipline with pragmatic decision-making, relationship-led lending, and a clear focus on delivering the right outcomes for customers. This is a fast-paced and constantly evolving department where no two days are the same. Deals are time-critical, varied, and often bespoke, requiring commercial thinking, sound judgement, and a willingness to take ownership from day one. As the Bridging proposition continues to grow, the role and the department evolve week by week. The team is lively, proactive, and highly collaborative. People are trusted to act like owners, take responsibility for their decisions, and work closely with colleagues across Distribution, Credit, Operations, and external partners to keep things moving. There is a strong emphasis on keeping things clear and simple, working at pace, and removing unnecessary barriers to getting good deals done. True to Allica’s values, the Bridging Department is built on teamwork, transparency, and doing the right thing for customers and the Bank. Ideas are welcomed, expertise is respected, and individuals are encouraged to challenge constructively, improve processes, and contribute to the continued success of a growing SME-focused lender. Role Description The Client Services – Team Lead is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a team of Client Services Associates and Managers, driving high performance, accountability, and strong credit outcomes. The role plays a key part in building capability across the team, supporting individual development plans and succession planning, and fostering a culture where the team feel confident to challenge, escalate, and continuously improve. Alongside people leadership, the role holds responsibility for packaging and structuring complex bridging transactions, ensuring lending decisions align with the Bank’s Credit Policy, risk appetite, and asset strategy, while delivering fast, high quality outcomes for SME and professional property clients. The Client Services -Team Lead plays a critical role within Allica Bank’s Bridging proposition, supporting the delivery of fast, flexible lending solutions to SME and professional property clients. Client Services are responsible for working with the BDMs in increasing originations, structuring Indicative Terms and carrying out an initial assessment of borrowing requests to evaluate feasibility and alignment with the Bank’s credit appetite. Acting as the first point of “triage”, the role determines whether enquiries are suitable to progress, ensuring only well-structured, viable applications are submitted to Credit. This early intervention is fundamental to maintaining pace, quality, and conversion through the lending journey. The role works closely alongside Business Development Managers and the Credit team, supporting the effective transition of enquiries into fully packaged applications. Client Services Associates prepare high-quality files for submission, ensuring key information is captured accurately and efficiently to support timely credit decisioning. The Client Services – Team Lead may also be involved in originating, structuring, and progressing bridging applications from Introducers and Borrowers, from initial enquiry through to completion. Client Services act as a trusted point of contact for brokers, providing clarity, guidance, and responsiveness throughout the early stages of the process. The role also involves liaising with third parties such as surveyors and solicitors, coordinating activity to help drive cases smoothly towards completion. Principal Accountabilities  Provide clear day-to-day leadership to the Client Services team, setting expectations on quality, pace, and behaviours.  Own the allocation of new and existing bridging cases, ensuring fair distribution.  Actively manage the pipeline to maintain momentum on time-critical transactions and Reallocate work where necessary to avoid delays or bottlenecks  Serve as the primary escalation and guidance point for questions from the team.  Coach and develop the team through regular feedback, case reviews, and on-the-job learning.  Conduct regular case reviews, quality assurance, and feedback sessions. Generate Indicative Terms and progress loan applications within agreed service level agreements (SLAs), utilising appropriate credit data and analytical tools.  Proactively manage the application journey from initial enquiry through to completion, coordinating effectively with panel solicitors, valuers, project monitors, asset managers, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely instruction, accurate documentation, and smooth case progression.  Undertake regular checks, Customer due diligence, and monitor agreed controls to ensure the Bank’s risk and customer requirements are met at all times, escalating immediately any areas of concern.  Produce clear, accurate, and concise written documentation to support high-quality credit decisioning, making well-reasoned recommendations to the Credit team and ensuring all activity is accurately recorded and maintained within CRM systems.  Liaise effectively with applicants, intermediaries, valuers, solicitors, and other third parties to obtain additional information required to support applications and resolve issues efficiently through to completion.  Deliver a consistently high standard of service to customers, brokers, Relationship Managers, and Business Development Managers, building and maintaining strong, trusted relationships in line with the Bank’s values and defined customer experience standards  Actively support external Business Development Managers by identifying, developing, and nurturing new broker and customer opportunities, contributing to the growth of the Bridging proposition and conversion of enquiries into applications  Ensure full compliance with all mandatory policies, regulatory requirements, and credit procedures, maintaining robust internal controls and governance standards at all times Support the development and ongoing enhancement of management information (MI) and key performance indicators (KPIs), maintaining accurate and timely reporting to provide clear visibility of the mortgage and bridging processing pipeline  Proactively identify opportunities for improvement across the Bank and the Client Services team, taking ownership for delivering enhancements and setting a positive example through behaviours aligned to Allica’s values  Where applicable, complete monthly assurance and quality assurance dip-testing on cases agreed for direct reports, providing clear feedback, guidance, and development support as required. Personal Attributes & Experience  Credible leader who builds trust quickly with underwriters, brokers, and senior stakeholders.  Demonstrable experience leading, coaching, or mentoring underwriters.  Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and confidence in decision-making.  Balance speed with risk discipline, ensuring complex or higher-risk cases receive appropriate senior input  Strong experience in the Bridging sector, with an understanding of the competitive landscape, key market dynamics, and current trends in short-term property finance.  Strong analytical capability combined with clear, confident verbal and written communication skills, enabling the role holder to assess enquiries effectively and communicate decisions, rationale, and next steps clearly to brokers, customers, and internal stakeholders.  A pragmatic and confident problem-solver who consistently stands out from their peers through the ability to assess complex scenarios, apply sound commercial judgement, and clearly justify decisions in line with the Bank’s credit appetite and customer outcomes.  Highly organised with excellent time-management and prioritisation skills, able to deliver accurate, high-quality work in a fast-paced, time-critical environment while managing multiple cases simultaneously.  A relationship-led professional who builds strong, trusted, and lasting relationships with internal stakeholders including Distribution, Operations, Credit, and senior management, as well as with external partners such as intermediaries, valuers, and solicitors.  Demonstrates a strong understanding of, and commitment to, regulatory requirements, internal policies, procedures, risk controls, and service level expectations, with a disciplined and responsible approach to governance.  Good working knowledge of Treating Customers Fairly (TCF), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Know Your Customer (KYC), and Conduct Risk, with a clear focus on doing the right thing for customers and the Bank.  Confident and capable user of technology, with experience of CRM systems and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word to support effective case management, reporting, and documentation. Working at Allica Bank At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers. Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind: Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities Options for flexible working Regular social activities Pension contributions Discretionary bonus scheme Private health cover Life assurance Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave Don’t tick every box? Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you! Flexible working We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate. Diversity We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like. title: Machine Learning Researcher
description: <h3>About the Position</h3> <p>Our goals are to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street as a Machine Learning Researcher while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. You'll work side by side with experienced ML Researchers on projects that we've selected for their combination of novel ML ideas and relevance to real-world systematic trading strategies. You'll learn how we think about markets through challenging classes and activities, and practice using established methods alongside our own unique twists to train practical models.</p> <p>At Jane Street, the lines between research, technology, and trading are intentionally blurry, and you’ll have access to petabytes of data, a computing cluster with hundreds of thousands of cores, and a growing GPU cluster containing tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Trading poses unusual challenges—large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment—that force us to search for novel techniques.</p> <p>You'll spend the bulk of your internship working closely with full-time machine learning researchers on projects drawn from their own work. You might conduct an end-to-end study of an unexplored dataset, try a new modelling paradigm for a thorny problem, or consider blue-sky approaches that we're still trying to figure out. The problems we work on rarely have clean, definitive answers, and they often require insights from colleagues across the firm with different areas of expertise. Depending on the day, you might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging training issues, or analysing the predictions your model makes.</p> <p>Note that given the IP-sensitive nature of machine learning research at Jane Street, it is unlikely that any research findings associated with the internship will be suitable for outside academic publication.</p> <h3>About you</h3> <p>If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:</p> <ul> <li>An undergraduate, PhD student, or postdoc with practical experience working on ML problems</li> <li>Interested in applying logical and mathematical thinking to all kinds of problems</li> <li>Curious about the machine learning landscape and excited to apply state-of-the-art techniques drawn from many problem domains</li> <li>Fluent with a versatile set of models and tricks</li> <li>Able to rapidly implement and iterate on your ideas in Python and your favourite ML framework</li> <li>Eager to ask questions, admit mistakes, and learn new things</li> <li>Fluent in English</li> </ul> <p>If you'd like to learn more, you can read about our <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/ml-research-interviews">interview process</a> and <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/get-to-know-us/">meet some of the team</a>. Learn more about Jane Street's internship program <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/internships/">here</a>.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Business Development Representative
description: About us Every large organisation runs on a web of legal entities, and the data behind them is scattered across in-house teams, law firms and accountants in PDFs, spreadsheets and slide decks. Jigsaw brings it into one place. We started by giving lawyers and accountants a faster way to model client structures, and became the category leader doing it. Today 240+ organisations use Jigsaw, including all 10 of the world’s top 10 accountancy firms. Now we’re building Entity Lifecycle Management: one live record for every entity, from formation to dissolution. Founded by former lawyer and repeat founder Stephen Scanlan, and backed by Exor Ventures. Why join us : You’ll help define a new software category with the backing of a loyal, global customer base. We hire people with high ownership and a bias for action, then trust them to do their best work. The role The primary role will be to seek new business opportunities by contacting and developing relationships with potential customers. You will use your initiative to discover leads, reaching out to prospects and building interest in Jigsaw. You will work closely with the Business Development team, executing the Account Executives’ targeted campaigns, as well as independently driving your own outreach. Working in a startup presents variety and multiple opportunities to take on additional responsibilities to expand beyond your normal role. Things can move fast and we’re looking for someone flexible and driven, with a natural ability to learn and quickly adapt. This is a fantastic opportunity to springboard into the exciting world of entrepreneurialism, offering potential for fast career growth and in-depth exposure to starting and growing a business. This is not just a job. If you are motivated, enjoy working in a dynamic team environment and would like to be part of the technology revolution, we’d like you to join us on our journey. Responsibilities Proactively seek new business opportunities in the market Contact potential clients through cold calls and emails Set up meetings or calls between (prospective) clients and Account Executives Report on (weekly/monthly/quarterly) sales results Requirements Excellent communication and people skills, including the ability to ‘think on your feet’ Ability to organize and prioritize workload Proven track record of achieving and exceeding goals Adaptability and resilience Prior Business Development experience is a bonus Based in or willing to relocate to London area Compensation: £33K • Offers Equity • £7.5K – £10K Commission • Uncapped Entry Level - London • Base salary £33K • Offers Equity • £7.5K – £10K Commission • Uncapped Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

A credible and confident communicator with demonstrated experience influencing C-suite and senior business stakeholders. Deep understanding of the full people partner toolkit - org design, workforce planning, talent management, succession, and complex ER. Data-literate with the ability to use people insights to shape strategy and tell compelling stories to stakeholders. Strong commercial acumen; you understand how people decisions drive business outcomes and can connect the dots between the two. Experience operating across multiple geographies and time zones, with an understanding of employment frameworks in the UK, Europe, and ideally APAC. title: Head of Engineering - Optimisation & Control
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🏡 Where you'll fit in: KrakenFlex is the flexibility arm of the Kraken group, built to put a big green dent in global carbon emissions by rewriting how electricity grids operate. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control. Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants. The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Currently operational across multiple countries, we are poised for further global expansion, scaling our asset base and tackling unique grid challenges in new territories. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant. What is Optimisation in Flex? The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns. The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies. The defining challenge for this chapter is scaling computational performance alongside our rapid asset growth. Running complex, multi-variable mathematical models in tight real-time windows requires immense efficiency. The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute. Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. Your goal is to architect a highly performant, modular optimisation core that uses standard abstract layers, allowing us to roll out new algorithms or expand into new global territories without rewriting the underlying engine. 🚀 What you’ll own: The Flex platform is built on autonomous Chapters, which are collections of specialists focused on delivering a core service or business outcome, defined by the unchanging nature of the energy business (independent of technology, hardware, or regional differences). A Head of Engineering leading a Chapter is a senior leadership role combining strong product thinking, engineering judgement, operational awareness, and people leadership. They manage managers and senior individual contributors, helping teams own their product surfaces, make sound trade-offs, and deliver reliably. This role requires influencing beyond its formal remit, spotting cross-team patterns, clarifying ownership and decision-making, and driving initiatives to turn recurring issues into visible actions with owners, dates, and measures of success. Ultimately, they maintain the technical vision for their specific area, ensuring services are appropriately owned, maintained, and aligned with Flex's sustainable growth. Managing the leads. Maintaining the technical vision for a given area. The overall team architecture Ensuring the services in that area are owned and maintained appropriately. Ensuring that product features are built in a way that scales, is cost-effective, and is in line with the vision for a product area. Ensuring the appropriate level of quality and resilience, with a specific focus on reducing system incidents and improving stability. Ensuring appropriate tech debt is prioritised to support sustainable delivery. Potentially managing a squad (team) as well. 🧠 What you’ll bring to the party: You’ll be a strong fit if you have experience leading engineering teams across multiple squads, teams or product areas in a complex product environment. A collaborative product and engineering mindset: you care about customer outcomes, product strategy, technical quality and the people needed to make the work real. Strong judgement in ambiguity: you can separate urgent from important, make trade-offs explicit and help teams move without pretending all uncertainty has disappeared. A track record of influencing beyond your reporting line and team, building trust with senior stakeholders and helping teams reach decisions when ownership is shared. A bias for action and improvement: when you see a recurring issue, you turn it into the smallest useful action that starts making the system better. Reliability in driving initiatives: people can trust that when you take ownership, the work keeps moving, dependencies are managed and decisions are followed through. Strong people leadership practice, including coaching, direct feedback, performance management, delegation, psychological safety and development of future leaders. Are you ready for a career with us? description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London | 💰 £60k – £80k base salary | £100k – £135k OTE  + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits">Benefits</a></p> <h3><strong>Our Monzo Business team ⭐</strong></h3> <p>Monzo Business helps businesses manage their money, and more than a million businesses (1 in 6!) in the UK bank with us. Now, we’re exploring how we can help more established businesses switch to Monzo, across the UK and Europe 🚀</p> <p>Many of those businesses have more complex needs. They may need help understanding whether Monzo is right for them, moving their banking or getting the most from our products. A great conversation with the right person can make a real difference.</p> <p>We’ve started building a sales team and testing a more personal approach. Now we’re looking for a Sales Manager to lead a team of Account Executives and help us turn what we’re learning into a repeatable, effective sales motion.</p> <p>This is a chance to build something new. You’ll coach your team, help them deliver great results and use what you see every day to make the way we sell better. You’ll work closely with Revenue Operations (RevOps), Product and other teams to improve our processes and customer journeys.</p> <p>You’ll also help build an AI-first sales motion from the start. We want someone who’s curious about AI and automation, actively experiments with new tools and can help the team spend more time on conversations that matter.</p> <h3><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Leading a team of Account Executives.</strong> Manage a pod of 6–8 people and be accountable for its performance, from reaching the right businesses and converting opportunities to customer activation and quality. Translate the wider Business strategy and set clear expectations, understand what’s driving results and act when performance needs to improve.</li> <li><strong>Coaching and developing your team.</strong> Spend time listening to calls, reviewing opportunities and giving clear, regular feedback. Help each person build their skills and confidence, recognise great work and address underperformance fairly. Help hire and onboard new team members as we grow.</li> <li><strong>Building the sales motion.</strong> Turn what you and your team learn into better ways of working. Spot friction in lead handling, follow-up, handovers and the sales process; test improvements, measure their impact and share what works so we can build a repeatable playbook.</li> <li><strong>Staying close to customers.</strong> We expect Sales Managers to also take a few sales calls each week and make a few sales a month. Use what you learn from customers and the sales journey to coach the team, identify product needs and improve the motion. Most of your time will be spent leading the team and improving how we work.</li> <li><strong>Helping shape our Products.</strong> Share what you learn from customers with Product to help shape our proposition and priorities, and use what we learn to improve how we sell.</li> <li><strong>Putting AI and automation to work.</strong> Experiment with tools, agents and workflows that help the team research prospects, prepare for conversations, follow up or learn from calls. Work with specialist teams to test ideas responsibly, understand their impact and help the team adopt what works.</li> <li><strong>Making good decisions with data.</strong> Use pipeline, conversion, activation, productivity and quality data to understand where the team is doing well and where customers or opportunities are getting stuck. Keep the pipeline accurate and work with RevOps on reporting and forecasting.</li> <li><strong>Working as one team.</strong> Bring frontline insight to RevOps, Product, Marketing and Operations. Help shape the tools, processes and customer journeys Sales needs, and work together to solve problems that affect your team and customers.</li> <li><strong>Earning customers’ trust.</strong> Build a culture that puts customers first. Coach your team to understand their needs, represent Monzo accurately and deliver good outcomes. Raise concerns early and work with Risk, Compliance and Legal when needed.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You’ve managed and developed a sales team. You can share examples of how you’ve coached individuals, given feedback and improved performance, including when conversations were difficult.</li> <li>You understand selling to small and medium-sized businesses in a relatively high-volume environment. You can balance an efficient process with thoughtful, customer-focused conversations.</li> <li>You’re a builder. You’ve spotted a problem in how a team sells, tried a better approach and helped people put it into practice. You’re comfortable making progress when the playbook is still being written.</li> <li>You’ve actively experimented with AI or automation at work and are keen to explore what agents and new workflows can do. You can tell us what you tried, the problem you were solving and what you learned.</li> <li>You’re happy to stay hands-on with customers. You enjoy sales conversations yourself and use what you learn to help others improve.</li> <li>You use data to understand performance. You can look at a funnel or pipeline, ask good questions and turn the answers into practical action.</li> <li>You work well with people in different teams. You can explain what your team and customers need, share evidence and help colleagues find solutions together.</li> <li>You care about doing the right thing for customers. You’re comfortable working within clear standards and learning what it takes to sell in a regulated environment.</li> <li>You might have built your experience in financial services, technology or another business selling to businesses. We care more about what you’ve done and how you think than the exact path you took to get here.</li> <li>You don’t need to tick every box. If this role excites you and you think you could make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t have everything that’s listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <h3><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></h3> <p>💰 £60k – £80k base salary, plus on-target commission based on team performance. Total on-target earnings are approximately £100k – £135k</p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office. You’ll work from the office at least 3 days a week to stay close to your team.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Read our <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">full list of benefits</a>.</p> <h4><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></h4> <ul> <li>30-minute introductory call with a recruiter</li> <li>A full interview loop covering role-specific skills, behaviours and values</li> <li>A conversation with a member of the team</li> <li>Final interview with the hiring manager at our London office</li> </ul> <p>We’ll share more details about the interview process and timing as you progress. Your schedule is important to us, so we’ll be as flexible as possible.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">read them here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-OH #LI-LONDON</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

title: General Counsel (Office based)
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong> to lead Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function and to build the legal architecture a public company needs — commercial contracting, corporate governance, intellectual property and compliance — in a software business that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will report to the Chief Operating Officer and advise the CEO, CFO and the Board directly.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: <strong>Location</strong>: This role can be home-based in EMEA, or office-based in our London, UK office.</p> <h3><strong>About our team</strong></h3> <p>Canonical’s Legal and Compliance function is a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. It owns the terms on which Ubuntu and our commercial products reach the market: open source and intellectual property licensing, enterprise and channel contracting, data protection, export controls and trade, competition, and the governance a company preparing to list has to be able to evidence.</p> <p>Canonical is founder-led, profitable and growing, and privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. That makes this a function in transition. The work is as much building the architecture — a management layer across two regions, standard contracting positions, controls, policies and records — as it is advising on live matters, and it is done in a company that regularly does things the industry has not done before, so the precedents often do not exist.</p> <p>The team works with Product and Engineering on licensing and IP, with Security on customer assurance, with Finance on listing readiness and controls, and with Sales on the commitments we make to customers. As General Counsel you lead that team, set its standards, and advise the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board and its committees directly.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the global Legal and Compliance function: set its structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas, so the business gets consistent answers wherever it operates.</li> <li>Build the management layer: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Set the operating cadence of the function: how legal work is taken in and prioritised, what internal clients can expect and when, and how workload and risk are reported to the leadership team.</li> <li>Own public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advise the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and support Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Own the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.</li> <li>Lead intellectual property and open source licensing strategy: permissive and copyleft licences, trademark, and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.</li> <li>Own the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition, and AI regulation.</li> <li>Manage litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, and own the external counsel panel, its budget and the quality of its work.</li> <li>Advise on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Qualified as a lawyer, with a law degree or equivalent and an active licence to practise in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.</li> <li>In-house legal leadership in a software or technology company — a business that licenses its own products, rather than one that buys technology to run its operations.</li> <li>Commercial technology contracting: enterprise software and subscription agreements, channel and reseller agreements, cloud and services, and hardware manufacturer agreements.</li> <li>Open source licensing: permissive and copyleft licences, trademark, and how open source communities work in practice.</li> <li>Corporate governance for a listed company, or for one preparing to list: board and committee support, delegated authority, disclosure and controls.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones.</li> <li>Building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under-performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English, with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally two to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practising as counsel inside a listed company.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How we work</strong></p> <p>We look for a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results, backed by self-motivation and drive. Our people deliver their work precisely, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity. Reliability is at our core, where colleagues deliver high quality work that builds trust and confidence. We make ourselves accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable. Finally we are adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</p> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

As we grow, there’s a big opportunity to evolve how our brand shows up and make those experiences feel connected.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Brand Designer</strong> to help shape the future of Monzo’s visual identity, lead and develop designers, and set a high bar for creative work across the company.</p> <p>You’ll join our digital-first internal creative studio and work closely with our Global Creative Director, designers and writers. You’ll also partner with teams across Product Design and Marketing, as well as external agencies, to bring ambitious ideas to life.</p> <p>This is for a designer who loves getting into the detail as much as shaping the bigger picture and helping others grow. You’ll bring strong conceptual thinking, art direction and typography to your work, and support a team of designers to do their best work too.</p> <h4><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Shaping our creative direction.</strong> Work with the Global Creative Director and partners across Monzo to evolve our visual identity and set a clear strategic direction for how the brand shows up globally.</li> <li><strong>Leading ambitious work. </strong>You’ll lead projects from idea to delivery and oversee work led by others, helping the team solve problems and deliver their best work. You’ll spot opportunities, create briefs and bring the right people together to make ideas happen. You’ll thrive working across multiple projects and teams at once.</li> <li><strong>Creating standout design.</strong> You’ll lead by example, setting a high bar for craft, concept and execution across the team. You’ll bring ideas to life across campaigns, marketing, product and other brand touch points, inspiring others through the quality of your work.</li> <li><strong>Managing and developing designers.</strong> Lead and support a small team of designers, helping them grow through regular feedback, coaching and career development conversations. Use Monzo’s levelling frameworks to support their progression and set clear expectations.</li> <li><strong>Raising the bar across the team.</strong> Lead critiques, share thoughtful feedback and mentor designers beyond your direct reports. Help create the conditions for people to do their best work.</li> <li><strong>Connecting brand and product.</strong> Partner with Product Design teams to bring Monzo’s brand to life in the app, including developing visual concepts, art direction and motion storyboards for customer experiences.</li> <li><strong>Evolving our brand systems.</strong> Develop guidelines, design principles and reusable assets that help teams create consistent, distinctive work as Monzo grows.</li> <li><strong>Influencing decisions across teams.</strong> Bring people together around a creative vision, explain the thinking behind your work and navigate trade-offs between customer needs, creative ambition and business goals.</li> <li><strong>Working with creative partners.</strong> Collaborate with external agencies and specialists, providing clear direction and feedback to make sure their work feels right for Monzo.</li> <li><strong>Improving how we work.</strong> Spot opportunities to make our creative process more effective, whether that’s through new tools, better ways of working or clearer guidance for teams.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have a strong portfolio of brand design and campaign work, showing how you’ve developed distinctive creative ideas and brought them to life across different channels.</li> <li>You’re an expert in your craft, with particular strength in <strong>typography, visual identity and art direction</strong>. You care about the details and can show how they make the overall work stronger.</li> <li>You have <strong>experience managing and developing designers</strong>, including giving feedback, supporting career growth and helping people do their best work.</li> <li>You’ve led complex creative projects from brief to delivery, making decisions, bringing people with you and maintaining a high standard throughout.</li> <li>You can think beyond a single project: you’ve helped shape a brand’s direction, developed design systems or guidelines, or improved how creative work happens across a team or organisation.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working with ambiguity. You can define a direction, navigate competing priorities and make thoughtful trade-offs without losing sight of the bigger picture.</li> <li>You’re proactive, creating your own briefs, bringing the right people together to accomplish your goals. You’re not just a doer, but a problem solver and a self-starter.</li> <li>You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, working across multiple teams and projects at the same time. </li> <li>You’re a confident collaborator who can explain and advocate for your ideas with designers, cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>You enjoy raising the quality of design beyond your own work, through mentoring, critique and sharing what you know.</li> <li>You’re highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using the tools you need to develop and deliver your ideas. You have a clear interest in AI tools and are keen to explore and use them to evolve how we work and what we create across design, marketing and product.</li> <li>You have experience working in a digital-first brand, creative agency or in-house team, and can show how your work has supported customer or business goals.</li> <li>You can develop ideas for motion and communicate them through storyboards or creative direction. You don’t need to be a motion specialist.</li> </ul> <p>We’d also love to see experience across areas such as web design, campaigns, print, film, illustration or 3D. You don’t need to be an expert in all of them.</p> <h4><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></h4> <p>💰 <strong>£98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</strong></p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home. All employees are given a MacBook.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Take a look at our<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> benefits</a>.</p> <h4><strong>🌈 The application journey</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>30-minute call with our Recruiter</strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Brand Design team. </strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour interview covering values & ways of working. </strong></li> </ul> <p>To be considered for this role you will need to include your CV and a portfolio showcasing your work. This will allow us to better understand your experience. We’d particularly love to see projects you’ve led from start to finish, including the thinking behind the work, the impact it had and your individual contribution.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using AI to support your application and interviews at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. title: Office Administrator
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring <strong>London Office Administrators </strong>to help take responsibility for the success of our London office. </p> <p>Our office administrators are part of our global business services team which covers business services, travel and logistics, events, expense management and administration. We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is an office-based role based in London.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Create a professional, positive and welcoming environment for colleagues and guests</li> <li>Proactive management of front-of-house, meeting rooms and desk space</li> <li>Clerical, administrative and logistical tasks such as ordering supplies, office equipment, and processing invoices</li> <li>Creating and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Cross team collaboration across the company</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for</h3> <ul> <li>Excellent academics</li> <li>Excellent spoken and written English skills</li> <li>Responsible and accountable</li> <li>Self-awareness and thoughtfulness</li> <li>Ability to travel up to twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration</li> <li>Ability to grasp our existing technical systems and suggest improvements</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills</li> <li>Adaptability in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Pension and medical insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

Use evidence to guide where to invest, what to change and when we’re ready to scale.</li> <li><strong>Earn customers’ trust</strong>. Build a sales culture that puts customers first and delivers good outcomes, working with our Risk, Compliance and Legal teams as we grow.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’ve built or substantially changed an SMB sales motion in an early or ambiguous environment, and helped it grow into a repeatable, high-performing operation. You can tell us what you built, what you learned and what changed as you scaled.</li> <li>You understand selling to small and medium-sized businesses, including how to build a relatively high-volume, efficient motion with shorter sales cycles. You know how to combine human conversations with digital journeys.</li> <li>You’re an experienced sales leader and coach. You’ve hired and developed teams, managed performance and helped people do their best work. You’re comfortable getting close to customers and deals yourself.</li> <li>You think about the whole system. You understand how customer acquisition, marketing, product, people, processes, data and technology fit together, and can see where a change in one part affects the rest.</li> <li>You use AI and automation in your own work and have applied them to change how the team operates. You can explain the problem you were solving, what you tested, how you brought people along and what difference it made. </li> <li>You’re a practical change leader. The next phase is both challenging and exciting: growing our customer base, expanding into Europe, evolving our product range, and helping customers make better decisions across cash, investments and pensions.</p> <h4><br>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</h4> <p>Reporting to the Head of Wealth Operations, you’ll be responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations of a Wealth product line (Savings, Investments or Pensions). You’ll also help refine our operations strategy and optimise key processes to help us safely scale our products and features to millions of customers. </p> <p>You won't have a team to run day-to-day; instead you'll lead through influence, structure and expertise - bringing order to complex, cross-functional planning cycles, taking non-technical delivery work off engineers' plates, and being accountable for the success metrics in your area. You'll do this across two big strategic bets: going deep in the UK market and expanding our products into Europe, all while we scale to millions more customers.</p> <p>You will be able to leverage our established and award-winning customer service operations whilst also working closely with the Product, Engineering, Partnerships and Risk & Compliance teams to deliver a delightful experience for our users. In time, your remit may also expand to cover other products.</p> <ul> <li>Develop and implement operational strategies to enhance the growth of Monzo's Wealth business</li> <li>Drive high-impact initiatives in your area, defining how we implement compliant, scalable processes that are built for efficiency.</li> <li>Navigate ambiguity to bring structure to complex cross-functional planning cycles — including the operational readiness required for EU market expansion and deeper UK propositions.</li> <li>Ensure efficient, compliant, and seamless delivery of operations, serving as the key contact for escalations</li> <li>Drive best practices within the team for all internal operations, both supplier-facing and customer-facing</li> <li>Work with product managers, engineers, and designers to enhance product and customer experiences</li> <li>Monitor key performance and risk indicators to improve customer experience and operational performance, and manage regulatory compliance with Risk & Governance</li> <li>Oversee third-party provider effectiveness and collaborate with the Commercial & Partnerships Manager to optimise partnerships and operations</li> <li>Ad hoc project manage the implementation of new initiatives, such as supplier integrations, where appropriate</li> <li>Identify where digital tools and new technologies can make us more effective, and put them to work.</li> <li>Advocate for customers - don't just report feedback, but persuade Product Leads to adjust roadmaps based on qualitative and quantitative trends so we solve the most impactful problems.</li> </ul> <h4><br>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</h4> <ul> <li>Proven track record in designing and managing operations within financial services, banking, or regulated industries</li> <li>Hands-on experience in savings, securities, investment operations and/or wealth product, custody operations, transfers, reconciliations, ISA/SIPP administration</li> <li>Working familiarity with the relevant FCA and HMRC rules - e.g. CASS, ISA Regulations, COBS - and comfort operating them day-to-day</li> <li>Experience launching and scaling consumer products and working with third-party providers</li> <li>Strong ability to drive tangible outcomes, thrive in ambiguity with structured problem-solving, and challenge the status quo</li> <li>Analytical in developing scalable operational strategies, identifying key metrics to evaluate success, and highly detail-oriented</li> <li>Collaborative communicator, able to work effectively across functions, levels, and cultures, with clear and persuasive communication skills</li> <li>Fast learner who is humble, curious, and enthusiastic about building and scaling new initiatives to reach millions</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <h4><br>🙌 What’s in it for you</h4> <p>💰 £53,000 - £68,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role is based in our London office</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p> </p> <h4>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</h4> <ul> <li>20 min call with the recruiter</li> <li>Initial call with the Hiring Manager</li> <li>2 hours of technical and behavioural interviews</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-OS1<br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo.
